intro: The two design passes ran again on the finished page, as the rules require after big changes. They fixed four things that change nothing you approved: the delivery price no longer breaks across lines on the puppy cards, the menu links are easier to tap, no list line ends on a single stray word, and the side-rail labels sit evenly. These five would change something you see, so each waits for you. The screenshots are here: https://claude.ai/artifact/RJscU1NMGaL4ijCn2sxpvi

questions.context: Recommended: (a). Why: the brass button already says "act here"; a coloured side stripe on a rounded card is a well-known "template" look. Trade-off: the cards look quieter.
questions.question: The new enquire buttons sit on cards with a thick brass stripe down the left edge. Swap it for a thin steel outline all round?

questions.context: A screen reader still reads the full sentence. Recommended: (a). Why: no line starts with punctuation, and no approved words change. Trade-off: on screen, the sentence is one comma different from the board.

options.label: Reword the four sentences instead (changes approved words)

questions.question: On a phone, the line after each enquire button starts with a stray comma (", and tell us which puppy…"). Hide that comma on screen?

questions.context: Recommended: (a). Why: these are the lines a buyer checks before enquiring. Trade-off: each puppy card is about 28px taller on a phone. Tablets and desktops don't change.
questions.question: On a phone, the statement-label notes and the puppy cards' "comes home with" and delivery lines are 13px, the smallest text on the page. Make them 14px on phones?

questions.context: This changes every page's header. Recommended: (a). Why: 48px more reading space on every phone screen, and the "Available puppies" button stays in view. Trade-off: the word "Open menu" becomes a menu icon (screen readers still announce it), which a few buyers may find less obvious.
questions.question: On a phone, the site header is two rows and 121px tall on every screen. Make it one 73px row, with the menu as an icon?

questions.context: Recommended: (a). Why: each card gets the width it was designed for. Trade-off: three rows instead of two, so the section is about 84px taller.
questions.question: On a desktop, the six puppy cards sit three across and are cramped (the colour and delivery lines wrap awkwardly). Show them two across, as on a tablet?

title: London Harden pass · five small design calls
